summary: no downgrade path: Pro users can't return to Free tier
description:
There is no UI path for a Pro user to return to the Free tier. The Account page (src/app/(app)/account/page.tsx) shows an UPGRADE button only for free users; the Pro card just says CURRENT with no action. The only "billing management" link is a vague "Manage in Clerk" anchor — Clerk does not own subscription state here.

Today, downgrade ONLY happens when an operator manually cancels the subscription in the Stripe dashboard, which fires:

  src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts:145-206
    customer.subscription.deleted   → users.tier = 'free'
    customer.subscription.updated   → users.tier = 'free'
                                       (status: canceled/past_due/unpaid)

That webhook handling is correct and tested (src/__tests__/stripe.test.ts:145-190). The bug is the missing user-facing trigger.

Recommended fix — Stripe Customer Portal:

  1. New route: src/app/api/portal/route.ts
       POST handler creates a billing-portal session via
       stripe.billingPortal.sessions.create({
         customer: user.stripe_customer_id,
         return_url: <account page>,
       })
       and returns { url }.

  2. Account page button (replaces or supplements "Manage in Clerk"):
       Pro users see "MANAGE SUBSCRIPTION" button that POSTs to
       /api/portal and redirects to session.url. Free users
       continue to see UPGRADE only.

  3. Stripe Customer Portal handles cancel, update card, view
     invoices, switch plans — all out-of-the-box. Existing
     webhooks already pick up the resulting state changes; no
     new server logic needed beyond the portal session creator.

  4. Configure portal features in Stripe Dashboard
     (Settings → Billing → Customer portal): enable cancel,
     update payment method, invoice history. One-time setup
     per environment.

Alternative (rejected): build a custom in-app cancel flow that
calls stripe.subscriptions.update({ cancel_at_period_end: true }).
More code, more edge cases, no real benefit over the hosted portal
which Stripe maintains and translates.

Done when:
  - Pro user can click a button on /account that opens the
    Stripe portal in the same tab.
  - Cancelling in the portal eventually downgrades the user
    (covered by existing webhook + tests).
  - tsc + lint + build clean. Add a route test for /api/portal
    that mocks Stripe and verifies session creation +
    redirect URL shape.

Spec: live user feedback during pre-launch cleanup.
